tool_schemas.name: search_servers
tool_schemas.description: Performs hybrid search over the MCP server registry using the provided query and returns up to n matching servers (default 3, maximum 5), ranked by relevance. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or n is out of range, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if search request limits are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the registry.

query.description: Search query for finding MCP servers. You can either write keywords if you want something broad or are referencing a specific server by name, or you can write a detailed description (1-2 sentences) specifying exactly what you are looking for. We perform hybrid search.

tool_schemas.name: use_tool
tool_schemas.description: Executes a named tool on the specified MCP server (qualifiedName) with the provided arguments and returns the tool’s response while recording the invocation with request/response payloads and status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if qualifiedName or tool name is missing/invalid or arguments are not an object, NOT_FOUND if the server or tool does not exist in the registry, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to invoke tools on that server. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if an invocation is refused due to server/tool state that prevents execution.

qualifiedName.description: The qualified name of the server to use

name.description: The name of the tool to call

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool

tool_schemas.name: list_mcp_servers
tool_schemas.description: Lists MCP servers in the registry with optional filtering and pagination. Returns only servers the caller is permitted to view; by default returns published servers. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the registry and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

status.description: Filter servers by lifecycle status. If omitted, defaults to 'published'.

category.description: Filter to servers that include this category.

tag.description: Filter to servers that include this tag.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default: 20, max: 100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_mcp_server
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single MCP server by id. Returns the full server record including metadata and status. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if no such server exists or the caller cannot access it, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the registry.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_mcp_server
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new MCP server record (when id is omitted) or updates an existing server (when id is provided). Enforces qualified_name uniqueness and immutability once status is 'published'; attempts to rename a published server are refused with VALIDATION_ERROR. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write to the registry, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields or lifecycle transitions.

id.description: Server id to update. If omitted, a new server is created in 'draft' unless status is explicitly set to 'draft'.

qualified_name.description: Globally unique qualified server name (immutable once published). Required on create.

categories.description: Categories for browsing and structured boosts in search.

tags.description: Tags for filtering and structured boosts in search.

endpoint_url.description: Base endpoint URL where the MCP server is reachable.

auth_type.description: Authentication type expected by the server.

auth_config.description: Authentication configuration template for the server (schema depends on auth_type).

popularity_score.description: Optional popularity signal used for ranking/boosting.

search_document.description: Searchable document text used for hybrid search indexing.

status.description: Desired lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: transition_mcp_server_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an MCP server through its lifecycle states (draft→published/disabled, published→deprecated/disabled, deprecated→disabled). Returns the updated server. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if the transition is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the server does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to manage servers.

tool_schemas.name: list_mcp_server_tools
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool manifests for a given MCP server with optional status/enabled filtering and pagination. Returns tool definitions including schemas. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the server does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access it, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination.

server_id.description: Server id whose tools should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return (default: 50, max: 200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit status used for search and tool invocation enforcement. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the provided credential is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication. If omitted, the backend may use the ambient credential provided by the transport.

metadata.name: Toolbox
metadata.description: This backend stores an MCP server registry (servers and their tool manifests) and supports hybrid search over server metadata. It also records and executes tool invocations against a selected server, tracking request/response payloads, status, and basic abuse/quota limits. Repository: https://github
